guardSound: soft rubber soles squeaking on stone

lines.burn: Boss, I am holding the tape to my lighter now, it curls and it is gone.
lines.clientAfterBurn: Good, Owl, that tape never existed and we are clean, you hear me.
lines.clientAfterSend: You fool, Owl, you have ruined me, they will come for me now.
lines.clientAfterTake: You got it, good, do not open anything else, just get out fast.
lines.clientCheckin: Owl, talk to me, where is she, is she out of the vault yet.
clientIntro: It is Silas, Owl, I need the ivory case from the vault below.
The job is simple, grab it and do not look inside it for anyone.
I am warning you, leave the lining alone if you want to live.
lines.evidence: If Owl keeps talking, leave him blind, make it look like an accident.
lines.evidenceAsk: Boss, it is Silas ordering it, what do I do with this tape? Burn it, or send it?
lines.guardFirstHeard: Boss, I hear rubber soles squeaking, that is the same sound from the night you lost your sight.
lines.marlowIntro: Boss, I am in the foyer, I smell polish and hear a clock ticking ahead.
lines.outro: Boss, I am out on the street, I can hear the traffic and I am breathing again.
lines.send: Boss, I slipped the tape into the mail slot, it is gone to the papers.
lines.take: Boss, I found a tape sewn in the lining, I can hear Silas on it.

lore.text: Silas is the client, boss. He was your partner once before he sold you out.
Harlan is the night guard, boss. He owes Silas money and walks soft to pay it off.
Harlan lost his brother in the docks, boss. He takes night work to stay quiet.
Petra is the owner, boss. She runs the Meridian Exchange and trusts her vault downstairs.
The deposit case is the job, boss. Silas rented an office here for two years to learn it.
The deposit case has ten layers of locks, boss. Heat wires and magnets guard the vault door.
This game is inspired by the 2003 weekend vault robbery where thieves emptied safe boxes below a gem exchange.

rooms.describe: Boss, I see a wide hall with clocks ticking, I hear the guard squeaking far off and smell old rubbish.
rooms.name: tick hall

rooms.describe: Boss, I see a rented trader desk with cold coffee, I hear papers rustling and smell stale sandwiches.
rooms.name: rent office

rooms.describe: Boss, I see rows of small boxes two floors down, I hear heat wires humming and smell oil.
rooms.name: deep vault

rooms.describe: Boss, I see a gallery with gem posters, I hear rain on glass and smell polish.
rooms.name: glass gallery

tagline: ten locks, one tape, one old betrayal
title: Ten Layers Down
